2.23.23
Tablix.PageBreak
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.PageBreak element specifies the PageBreak behavior of a Tablix. This element is optional
and MUST NOT be specified more than once. If this element is specified, it is of type PageBreak.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.PageBreak element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.PageBreak element.
 <xsd:element name="PageBreak" type="PageBreakType" minOccurs="0" />
